title: Scoped PRD: operational specs and evidence scenarios for SAML SSO, RBAC mapping, KMS/HSM compatibility
creator: Aisha Patel
description: This ticket defines a scoped product requirements document and downstream acceptance/evidence scenarios for Private deployments focused on SAML SSO behavior, RBAC role mapping, audit log schema & retention, and KMS/HSM compatibility and operational runbooks. The goal is to produce deterministic acceptance tests and a signoff checklist that Security, Infra, and Customer Ops can use during onboarding to validate compliance requirements for regulated customers.
acceptance_criteria: SAML: SP-initiated and IdP-initiated flows validated end-to-end with assertion attribute mappings (email, sub, X-Redwood-Tenant) across 3 major IdPs (Okta, Azure AD, OneLogin) and automated test vectors recorded in CI
SAML: Assertion lifetime enforcement documented and enforced: max 5m authn instant clock skew, configurable session TTL, and token reuse detection with alerting

RBAC: Role mapping matrix created showing Redwood roles -> customer roles -> least-privileged actions, with automated policy tests that prove unauthorized API paths return 403 and authorized calls succeed
KMS/HSM: Verified compatibility with two HSM vendors (Yubico Edge HSM, AWS CloudHSM) for key wrapping/unwrapping flows and documented fallback behavior when HSM unresponsive

Audit logs: Event schema standardized (ISO8601 timestamps, event_id, actor, tenant_id, operation, resource, outcome, request_id) and retention policy enforced; logs are integrity-signed (SHA256) locally before export
Operational runbooks: Key compromise and emergency rotation playbook validated in staging and dry-run executed with no data loss for a sample tenant
Evidence bundle: For each onboarding, produce a signed evidence bundle (test matrix artifacts, logs, screenshots, PRs) that Security can accept for 'crypto-and-identity' signoff
Performance SLOs: SAML handshake validated under peak load (500 RPS simulated) with median <250ms and 99th <600ms for assertion exchange in Dedicated and Private modes
test_plan: Automated SAML test harness: add scenarios for assertion replay, expired assertions, invalid signatures, and unexpected attribute sets; CI job id: ci-saml-45217
RBAC policy smoke tests: script that exercises all role-action pairs using a fixture tenant; results uploaded to artifacts/redwood-rbac-45217.csv
HSM integration tests: HSM connectivity, latency, wrap/unwrap RTTs, and failure injection where HSM returns transient errors; recorded in eng/hsm-integration-45217.log
Audit integrity checks: sign/verify cycle executed on every log rotation in staging; mismatch must trigger PagerDuty
Manual runbook validation: Ops runs emergency rotation checklist with on-call rotation and files a postmortem with timeline and evidence
rollout_plan: Phase 1: internal validation in staging with synthetic tenants (2 weeks). Phase 2: pilot with 3 test customers under NDA in a single region (4 weeks). Phase 3: gradual rollout to GA for Private customers with an intake questionnaire and mandatory evidence package before onboarding. Each phase requires security signoff and at least one successful emergency rotation dry-run.
